title: Support Workflow
subtitle: Multi-Agent Support — Microsoft Agent Framework
description: Triage, KB search, automated resolution, and human handoff for end-user support tickets.

agents.title: Triage Agent
agents.description: Classifies the user's problem and routes to the right agent.

agents.title: Frequent Problem Agent
agents.description: Searches KB for known issues. Routes to human when no match.

agents.title: Resolution Agent
agents.description: Executes automated tools to resolve known issues.

agents.title: Human Support
agents.description: Sarah M. — human attendant joins when no KB match or automated resolution fails.

agents.title: Pattern Record Agent
agents.description: Records patterns and promotes repeated issues to the KB.
